comment: zap.c maybe_destroy_item() witness: a cold-resistant Valkyrie, Stressed by 80 potions, attacks thin air beside a freezing sphere, which explodes at her on its turn. Shattered potions lighten her to Burdened, and exercise()'s encumbrance line goes through maybe_destroy_item()'s message operation. The port's planning pass therefore prints nothing, so "You attack thin air." shares the top line with the explosion as in C instead of meeting an early --More-- from the long encumbrance line.
